column2: MagSafe power port Plug in the included 45W MagSafe Power Adapter to recharge the MacBook Air batery.
Port hatch Open the port hatch to use the headphone jack, USB 2.0 port,and Micro-DV port.
Headphone jack Connect external speakers or headphones.
USB (Universal Serial Bus) 2.0 port Connectan external optical disc drive, USB to Ethernet adapter, modem,iPod,mouse, keyboard,and more to your MacBook Air.You can also connect USB 1.1 devices.

Micro-DVI (video out) port Connect an external displayprojection device,orTV that uses a DVI,VGA,composite, or S-video connector. Depending on the type of external device you're connecting, you can use the included Micro-DVI to DVI Adapter or Micro-DVI to VGA Adapter.The Micro-DVI to Video Adapter, which provides composite and S-video support, is sold separately at www.apple.com/store.
